startup_iconified.description: If true, TkRemind starts up iconified (minimized).

show_todays_reminders.description: If true, shows a text window with reminders on startup.

confirm_quit.description: If true, prompts to confirm when quitting.

auto_close_popups.description: If true, automatic pop-up reminders close after one minute.

use_system_notifications.description: If true, uses desktop system notifications for reminders.

beep_on_reminder.description: If true, beeps the terminal bell on reminder.

deiconify_on_reminder.description: If true, restores the main window when a reminder pops up.

popup_command.description: Shell command to execute when a background reminder triggers.

feed_popup_to_command.description: If true, pipes the reminder text to the popup command's stdin.

email_on_undismissed.description: Email address to send reminders to if the user does not dismiss the popup.

smtp_server.description: IP address or hostname of the SMTP server for email notifications.

text_editor.description: Command for the text editor to edit reminder files. Use %s for file and %d for line number.

extra_remind_args.description: Additional arguments to pass directly to the 'remind' binary.
